key_insights.finding: Month-to-month contracts are the highest-risk contract type.
key_insights.evidence: Churn is 42.7% for month-to-month customers versus 2.8% for two-year customers (15.1x higher).

key_insights.finding: Churn is concentrated in the first year of tenure.
key_insights.evidence: Customers with 0-12 months tenure churn at 47.4% versus 9.5% for 49+ months.

key_insights.finding: Fiber optic customers show elevated churn.
key_insights.evidence: Fiber optic churn is 41.9% versus 19.0% for DSL, a 22.9 percentage-point gap.

key_insights.finding: Electronic-check customers are a high-priority payment-friction segment.
key_insights.evidence: Electronic-check churn is 45.3% versus 17.1% for other payment methods.

definitions.estimated_clv: Observed customer value proxy equal to cleaned TotalCharges; the public snapshot does not include margin, discount, or future-survival assumptions.
definitions.retention_trend: Retention by tenure band, because this snapshot has no transaction date or acquisition cohort date for calendar month-over-month analysis.
